build_arrow_writer: build a python module that uses ArrowWriter to write examples to an Arrow file with a given schema
build_parquet_writer: build a python module that uses ParquetWriter to write dataset examples to a Parquet file with snappy compression
create_typed_sequence: create a TypedSequence to convert a list of values into a PyArrow array with an inferred feature type
get_arrow_batch_size: get the optimal Arrow writer batch size from dataset features to avoid buffer overflows
get_parquet_batch_size: get the optimal Parquet writer batch size from data size to optimize row group access
